text: わたし　いろんな　トレーナーと　なんども　たたかい　たくて　これ　くばってるのよ　もらって　もらって！

structure.jp: わたし　いろんな　トレーナーと　なんども　たたかい　たくて
structure.en: I want to battle all sorts of Trainers again and again, so

structure.jp: これ　くばってるのよ
もらって　もらって！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb says you want to do it. Here it is in its て shape, たくて, which gives the reason for what comes next. たたかいたくて = 'I want to battle, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. てる is the short spoken form. くばってる = 'am handing out'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て with nothing after it is a friendly way to ask someone to do something. もらって = 'take it'.
